    # ---------------- feasibility circulation -----------------------------
    def build_aux(self):
        S, J, F, G = self.S, self.J, self.F, self.G
        n = self.K + 2
        self.SS = self.K
        self.TT = self.K + 1
        g = GL.Graph(n)
        amap = [g.add(self.tail[i], self.head[i], 0)
                for i in range(self.narcs)]
        base = [0] * len(g.cap)
        for s in range(S):
            blk = self.slot_blk[s]
            base[amap[blk[0]]] = self.I if s == 0 else self.refill[s]
            base[amap[blk[1]]] = self.B
            if blk[2] >= 0:
                base[amap[blk[2]]] = self.B
            base[amap[blk[3]]] = self.qcap[s]
        for i in range(self.dense_start, self.dense_end):
            base[amap[i]] = 1
        for i in self.win_arc:
            base[amap[i]] = 1
        for gidx in range(G):
            base[amap[self.group_arc[gidx]]] = self.gceil[gidx]
        base[amap[self.back_arc]] = J
        ss_arc = {}
        for v in sorted(set(self.fhead)):
            ss_arc[v] = g.add(self.SS, v, 0)
        tt_arc = [g.add(self.zbase + f, self.TT, 0) for f in range(F)]
        self.aux_g = g
        self.aux_map = amap
        self.aux_base = base
        self.aux_ss = ss_arc
        self.aux_tt = tt_arc
        self.aux_n = n

    def feasible(self, low, need_cut=False):
        """True when a feasible circulation realises `low` on the flow arcs."""
        total = 0
        for l in low:
            total += l
        if total == 0:
            return True, None
        cap = self.aux_base[:]
        amap = self.aux_map
